original_images.viewer_qa: Gold cylindrical Roman Catholic tabernacle with domed crown, small cross, complete recognizable front door, Chi-Rho relief, solid base. High clarity at original pixels; pale marble background. Cropping out floral arrangement on left and lamp edge at upper right can isolate the subject without altering its identity.
original_images.crop_guidance: Optional modest rectangular framing from the 5347×3565 original preserving cross and entire foot; crop decorative flowers left and unrelated object at upper right; publish only with CC BY 4.0 creator / licence / modification notice.

original_images.viewer_qa: True French Notre-Dame main-altar retable with substantial Annunciation painting, columns, Saints and ornamental surround. Entire altarpiece and altar furniture occupy nearly the whole photograph; dim interior/exposure and distracting additional small altar candlesticks. Good historical explanation image, but not high enough quality for primary atlas portrait.

Full clearly identifiable metal Communion rail with grape motifs, central panels, and stone step; sharp subject but modern freestanding altar table and opened liturgical book plainly visible behind it, which conflicts with Ad Orientem's single authentic high-altar setting standard.

reused_previous_original.viewer_qa: One complete 1848 Roman Catholic high altar in natural architectural setting: fixed rearward altarpiece and tabernacle, no added freestanding forward altar table, exactly six matching altar candlesticks visible three to either side, appropriate historic sanctuary furnishing. Photo sharp at 100%; paintings and statues are physically part of rear architectural setting. A high altar cannot be isolated from its integral church background as if it were a movable vessel.

policy: Architectural subjects may be depicted in complete isolated in-situ composition rather than portable white-background studio image. A near-whole altar with physically integral ornamentation is one architectural subject; a modern forward altar behind a rail disqualifies that photograph from the primary traditional setting. No other exceptions inferred.
